Name: (CP) Niko's Wizard Portrait (with Sprites)
Author: seaquestions
Description:
This is my first time making a mod for Stardew Valley, so I hope it works well! Just wanted a new Wizard portrait to fit my tastes. It also comes with lightly edited sprites to fit the colour scheme, one of them being the one from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]Romanceable Rasmodius[/url]. I use [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/580603-diverse-stardew-valley-dsv-seasonal]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url], so the art style of this portrait mod is meant to blend in w/ that.

Configuration:
Expressions: nine, two (changes number of expressions in portrait)
Sprite: vanilla, romras (changes spritesheet)

By default, it's two expressions & vanilla. Change to nine & romras for compatibility with Romanceable Rasmodius. Make sure the sprite & portrait are set to "custom" in that mod's config file.

Thank you! Let me know what you think! It's not currently compatible w/ SVE I don't think but maybe I'll do that sometime.
